seo_description: Full sound design for a short film. Every sound recorded from scratch with a Zoom H6, no sample libraries.
hero.title: Richter
hero.subtitle: Sound Design / Short Film / Field Recording, Synthesis, Foley, Orchestral Score
about.text: Sound design for a short film. No sample libraries. I recorded everything from scratch with a Zoom H6: footsteps on wood, concrete, carpet. Door sounds, paper, cloth. Built drones and risers in Vital, ReaSynth, and TAL Noisemaker. Wrote a short orchestral cue with strings and brass, timed to scene cuts. Mixed in Reaper.
video.title: Film
approach.title: Approach
approach.field_desc: Ambiences, room tones, textures. Zoom H6, all original recordings.
approach.synth_desc: Drones and risers in Vital, ReaSynth, TAL Noisemaker. Alarm sound is pure synthesis.
approach.foley_desc: Footsteps, doors, paper, cloth. Layered and processed in Cubase.
approach.mix_desc: Dialogue, SFX, ambience balanced in Reaper. Volume and EQ automation.
